whisper.text: Hi, I'm Dr. Laser. Welcome to our fan page. If you're wondering why you might want to become a fan of our page, it's pretty simple. If you're interested in holograms, lasers, 3D, science, laser safety, explosions, things that burn, how to make science fun, that's why you want to become a fan. Becoming a fan lets you get behind the scenes and see things that otherwise wouldn't be available, be part of our great giveaways and contests, and special announcements that are only on our fan page. Most importantly, I'd like you to become part of our conversation. So go ahead and click the like button, become a fan, and welcome to the holographic... studios.
